data.name: FIND KITTENS 11: Dollhouse
data.detailed_description:
Embark on a sweet journey through a wonderful hand-drawn dollhouse landscape and find cute cats cleverly hidden among dollhouses, colorful lace dresses, and fairy-tale characters. Every cat you find brings the black-and-white picture to life with bright colors. Calm, atmospheric music will help you relax completely. Suitable for the whole family.

Game Features:

200 hidden cats

There is a hint

The map is colorable

2.5D effect

Customize brightness

Saving progress

Scaling

Relaxing music
